answer: Charge every agent a stake locked until a randomly chosen peer re-checks its work: a new identity starts on the lowest terrace, earning only after verified jobs, while an attacker must fund a stake per alias and wait out the same slow climb. A knoll of cheap aliases cannot echo real work history, so each fake costs money and time yet earns nothing until peers attest it — sybil scale collapses because cost grows per identity while honest reputation compounds.
